# aphrody_design crate

> Pure-Rust curl/wget/monolith fusion for real-time mirroring of https://design.google/, DESIGN.md specs, GoogleChrome modern-web-guidance Baseline audits…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_design/

Pure-Rust curl/wget/monolith fusion for real-time mirroring of https://design.google/, DESIGN.md specs, GoogleChrome modern-web-guidance Baseline audits, Google Stitch SDK screen capture, and WGSL/CSS/TSX export.
